name: Irbid
registryBasis: City-local registry evidence is explicit: Greater Irbid Municipality’s official page “government institutions and departments” lists the Irbid Governorate Land Registration Directorate and its contact number among offices in the city. The official DLS 2023 annual report separately names the Irbid Land Registration Directorate and reports its land-registration transactions. This establishes a city-local land registry; it does not verify an anonymous safe parcel geometry endpoint or WUP-point coverage.
